messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning to roll router v2.3.1 into prod during tonight's change window (23:00 UTC). This requires pinning runtime to 2.3.0 stable; runtime folks please confirm runtime image available and migrations applied. Link to notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026/router-2.3.1

elaine: Confirming runtime image present on private registry. One thing: runtime v2.3.0 enabled new KV eviction heuristic; need to check console's header-slice API when under burst. @aj please validate console + API contract.

aj: I ran smoke against staging. Short failure when we hit 95% KV watermark — 502 observed from router -> runtime. Maybe batching param changed. Reproduced with load test.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: orchestrator:start wave=router v=2.3.1 token=deploy-1799990000. Preflight checks: ok. Canary (5%) started.

sre-oncall: If we see >1% 5xx in canary for 2 consecutive minutes, rollback automatically. Also set rate-limit to 200rps on router for this window.

elaine: Can we temporarily disable aggressive batching? Patch below to runtime config:

```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  latency_budget_ms: 20
```

sam: That change sounds reasonable. aj, can you push that config to canary runtime and re-run smoke?

aj: Pushed config to canary runtime via `kubectl apply -f runtime-canary-batch-patch.yaml`. Re-tested: no 502 at same load. Good.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 20% after 6m. No regressions observed. Console schemas OK. Rolling out to 50%.

oliver: Quick note — pin the router API contract to v2.3.x in Console route mapping. Will do.

sre-oncall: Remember to set alert TTL to 10m to avoid noise from transient clusters.

sam: Final decision — proceed with rollout. Rollback plan: use `deploy-bot rollback router 2.2.9` if 5xx > 1% for 3m or latency P95 increases > 250ms.

aj: I'll keep the watch dashboard open and call the channel if I see anything. :eyes:

sam: Thanks all :thumbsup:
